WITH signed AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
              WHEN type = 'VYDAJ'  THEN 0 - amount
              ELSE NULL END AS s
  FROM trans
),
acct AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(s) AS avg_s
  FROM signed
  GROUP BY account_id
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_s) AS overall_avg
  FROM acct
  WHERE avg_s IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       a.avg_s AS avg_signed,
       a.avg_s - o.overall_avg AS diff
FROM acct a
JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
WHERE a.avg_s > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC
LIMIT 10
